summary: Pandemic is a cooperative game where players work together as disease specialists, traveling the globe to treat infections and research cures before outbreaks cascade out of control. It's a tense, tightly-timed puzzle of resource and action management with a shared board that can spiral into losses if the infection deck turns against you.
praised: Iconic, accessible introduction to cooperative gaming
Strong tension and sense of shared crisis
criticised: Can suffer from a dominant 'alpha player' quarterbacking the group
Difficulty can swing heavily on card draw luck
Loses tension after many plays once strategies are known

interaction.kind: cooperative planning and shared board state
interaction.detail: All players share one board and one set of win/loss conditions, so every action (treating disease, trading cards, building stations) directly affects the whole team's chances. Turns are taken individually but decisions are made through constant group discussion about the shared map.

sources: cures discovered for the four diseases
scoring.how_you_win: Players cooperate, using actions and cards to treat infections and collect matching city cards to discover cures; the team wins once all four diseases have been cured before the player deck runs out or outbreaks spiral out of control.
